source_symbols_contract.parser: TypeScript 5.9.3 createSourceFile; syntax only, one Bun batch
source_symbols_contract.name: Local declared name; nested symbols remain separate entries in source traversal order
source_symbols_contract.line_start: Inclusive one-based first construct line, including decorators/modifiers but not leading comments
source_symbols_contract.line_end: Inclusive one-based last construct line, not a fixed declaration window
source_symbols_contract.signature: Source header with whitespace collapsed, capped at 400 characters including any truncation marker
source_symbols_contract.scope: Named declarations and class members; not ordinary object properties or anonymous callbacks
source_symbols_contract.empty: Non-source rows, unsupported extensions, syntax-invalid files, or no selected named constructs
source_symbols_contract.compatibility: Additive format-3 field; absent in older files. Original sections and citation bounds are unchanged
